title: Medway
label: Made of heavy metal
description: Medway is a geometric sans serif typeface. The original inspirations were Johnston and Gill Sans. This explains certain british design references (M, t, f, S & s, …) and an overall humanistic feeling. In order to advance into a transitional proposition, Frutiger’s Avenir & his eponymous font served as a basis for the refinement of the design. This resulted in high legibility and rational choices. As a result, Medway bears the mark of a humanistic approach to metal type design whilst incorporating modernist principles. The typeface is inviting and uplifting, though serious and efficient nonetheless.

title: Medway Schoolbook
description: This companion to the Medway brings a warmer feel, with details inspired by schoolbook typefaces (open 4, flicked a and d, serif I and J, …). It complements the family to cover a wide range of applications, from serious tones to playful uses.
label: Back to skool!

title: Type Finder
description: Type Finder uses direct manipulation as an alternative to current tools for typeface search. An asemic glyph, variable on five axes, allows designers to sketch the formal characteristics of the type of font they are looking for. Contextual component states help build strong affordances that guide the user naturally through the interface.
label: Assume form
